name: GSM Security Analysis
description: Ability to analyze the security of GSM (2G) cellular networks. Covers GSM air interface analysis, A5 cipher suite assessment, base station identification and characterization, IMSI/TMSI tracking analysis, and assessment of downgrade attack susceptibility. Includes operation of GSM test infrastructure for controlled security analysis.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to GSM security analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands GSM architecture, air interface, and known security weaknesses
evidence: Can describe the GSM protocol stack (Um, Abis, A interfaces) and their security properties
Understands A5/1, A5/2, and A5/3 cipher suites and their known weaknesses
Completed training on GSM architecture and security assessment methodology

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs GSM signal analysis and base station identification under supervision
evidence: Captured and decoded GSM broadcast channels (BCCH) using gr-gsm or equivalent under guidance
Identified cell IDs, LACs, and ARFCN configurations from captured GSM signals
Operated a controlled GSM base station (osmo-bts) in a shielded lab environment under supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently performs GSM security assessments in controlled environments
evidence: Independently analyzed GSM networks for cipher suite downgrade vulnerabilities across 3+ assessments
Decoded GSM signaling to identify IMSI/TMSI assignment and tracking exposure
Configured and operated GSM test infrastructure for controlled security analysis
Documented GSM security findings with protocol-level evidence and remediation guidance

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Performs advanced GSM protocol analysis; assesses IMSI catcher detection and resistance
evidence: Assessed effectiveness of IMSI catcher detection mechanisms in target environments
Performed deep protocol analysis of GSM signaling for non-standard or anomalous behavior
Developed custom GSM analysis tools or modified open-source GSM stacks for security testing
Mentors junior analysts on GSM security assessment and lab safety controls

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on GSM security; develops novel analysis techniques; defines lab methodology
evidence: Authored the lab's GSM security assessment methodology and shielded environment procedures
Published research on GSM security vulnerabilities or analysis techniques
Developed novel GSM interception detection or vulnerability assessment methods
Trains teams on GSM security analysis and provides expert guidance on cellular security

assessment_methods.description: Analyze a controlled GSM test network: decode broadcast channels, identify security configuration, assess cipher suite vulnerability, and document findings
Review GSM security assessment reports for protocol-level accuracy and finding completeness

equipment: RF shielded enclosure for cellular testing
